actions.aliasAUser.description: Change a user's identifier by merging two user identities into one
actions.aliasAUser.props.id.description: The old unique identifier of the user
actions.aliasAUser.props.new_id.descript: The new unique identifier of the user
actions.createOrUpdateUser.description: Create a new user profile or update an existing user profile with custom properties
actions.createOrUpdateUser.props.channel: Device tokens for push notifications and other communication channels
actions.createOrUpdateUser.props.data.de: Custom user properties (e.g., first_name, last_name, timezone). Reserved properties: language, timezone, userAgent
actions.createOrUpdateUser.props.email.d: The email address of the user
actions.createOrUpdateUser.props.id.desc: The unique identifier of the user
actions.deleteUser.description: Delete a user and all their properties and activities permanently. This action is irreversible.
actions.deleteUser.props.id.description: The unique identifier of the user to delete
actions.resubscribeUser.description: Globally resubscribe a user to all communications
actions.resubscribeUser.props.id.descrip: The unique identifier of the user
actions.trackEvent.description: Track a custom event for a user
actions.trackEvent.props.eventName.descr: Name of the event being tracked
actions.trackEvent.props.extras.descript: Additional metadata for the event (e.g., source, createdAt)
actions.trackEvent.props.userId.descript: Unique database identifier for the user
actions.unsubscribe.description: Globally unsubscribe a user from all communications
actions.unsubscribe.props.id.description: The unique identifier of the user
actions.updateUsersTags.description: Add or remove tags from a user profile
actions.updateUsersTags.props.add.descri: An array of tags to add to the user
actions.updateUsersTags.props.id.descrip: The unique identifier of the user
actions.updateUsersTags.props.remove.des: An array of tags to remove from the user
